title: Google\Cloud\RecaptchaEnterprise\V1\WebKeySettings
name: WebKeySettings
description: Settings specific to keys that can be used by websites.

params.name: data
params.description: Optional. Data for populating the Message object.

params.name: data.allow_all_domains
params.description: If set to true, it means allowed_domains will not be enforced.

params.name: data.allowed_domains
params.description: Domains or subdomains of websites allowed to use the key. All subdomains of an allowed domain are automatically allowed. A valid domain requires a host and must not include any path, port, query or fragment. Examples: 'example.com' or 'subdomain.example.com'

params.name: data.allow_amp_traffic
params.description: Required. Whether this key can be used on AMP (Accelerated Mobile Pages) websites.

params.name: data.integration_type
params.description: Required. Describes how this key is integrated with the website.

params.name: data.challenge_security_preference
params.description: Settings for the frequency and difficulty at which this key triggers captcha challenges. This should only be specified for IntegrationTypes CHECKBOX and INVISIBLE.
